name: Warden's Reckoning
author: NeoMud Team
description: A world where ancient seals are weakening and the line between guardian and destroyer must be chosen.
introScript:
A thousand years ago, the world cracked.

The Wardens sealed what crawled out, and paid for it with their bloodline.

The seals are weakening. The world has forgotten why they matter.

You are the last who can choose what the silence remembers.
releaseNotes: The Party Update: 4-player parties with shared XP, follow, party chat, leader promotion, and a party HUD overlay. Multi-target spells and an NPC ability system. Slash commands with /tell and cross-room invites, minimap party dots. Simplified loot: everything drops to the ground, first come first served. Graceful server-restart handling, vendor UI polish, and stone-themed tooltips throughout.
